attribution.note: Marcus states this forecast in his own voice.

semantics.note: The buildout prediction is firm. Excess capacity is only a possibility, preserved in the normalization and excluded from scoring by the contract.

contract.note: The contract fairly separates the firm buildout forecast from the hedged excess-capacity possibility. The precise horizon and buildout threshold do not affect the present result.

reviews.rationale: The firm forecast concerns substantial infrastructure buildout in both countries over several years after December 2025. That horizon has not elapsed, and the packet supplies no evidence meeting the early-resolution rule. The possibility of excess capacity is not independently adjudicable.
